title: Patch: Flexible is a Unit keyword, so Mender and Mass Driver lose it
notes: Issue #3828 (R3828000, superseding R3543001): Flexible is read on Units alone. S+ #40 Mender and S+ #59 Mass Driver lose Flexible, and Mass Driver its 0/6 (0/12 Radiant) stat line; the engine no longer offers a Field Spell a unit zone, and catalog check refuses Flexible on a non-Unit face. The plays are the families whose golden games deal Mender or Mass Driver and diverge with them.

player.title: Flexible is for Units only
balance: Mass Driver no longer has stats: it is a Field Spell with no 0/6 (0/12 Radiant).
changes: Flexible belongs to Units alone. Mender and Mass Driver lose it, so neither can be played into a unit zone, and a Flexible Unit played into the backrow counts as a Unit played for every card.
